pageTitle: Minnesota Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: Who Won the Biggest Minnesota Lottery and What Are the Odds?
items.answer: The Minnesota lottery winning numbers produce many winners. Unfortunately, the page doesn’t say who won the most substantial amount—one case delivered over $21,000,000.

items.question: What Channel Is the Minnesota Lottery On?
items.answer:
The Minnesota State lottery page doesn’t list a channel that hosts draws. Most Minnesota lottery numbers are picked with in-house draws.

You can check the results of the Minnesota lottery on the website, the Minnesota lottery app, or with the Minnesota lottery ticket scanner.

items.question: When Does the Minnesota Lottery Draw?
items.answer:
Daily 3 and Northstar Cash draw daily at 6:17 P.M. Gopher 5 draws at the same time, but only on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.

Minnesota lottery Powerball draws on Wednesday and Saturday at 9:59 P.M. while the Minnesota lottery Mega Millions draws at 10 P.M. on Tuesdays and Fridays.

Lotto America also draws at 10 P.M. but on Wednesdays and Saturdays. Minnesota lottery Lucky for Life draws occur every Monday and Thursday at 9:38 P.M.

items.question: How to Win the Minnesota Lottery?
items.answer:
Every variant has different odds. For example, the odds are 1 in 302,575,350 for Mega Millions, 1 in 25,989,600 for Lotto America, and 1 in 169,911 for Northstar Cash.

There’s no definite way to win any of these games, but you can choose a game with higher odds to increase your chances.

items.question: How to Play the Minnesota Lottery?
items.answer: Playing the lotto is simple. Buy a ticket from a retailer, and wait for the Minnesota lottery results. You can choose lucky numbers or buy a quick pick – a ticket with randomly generated numbers. You can also play various instant games.

items.question: How to Cash in Lottery Tickets in Minnesota?
items.answer: Minnesota lottery winners can claim a number of ways. Prizes with a value of up to $50,000 can be claimed by mail. Rewards of $599 or less can be claimed at any local retailer. However, prizes over $50,000 must be claimed at the headquarters in Roseville. The Minnesota lottery allows you to withdraw online funds as a store voucher.
